description:
Dublin Mudslide is an older Ben & Jerry's flavour that went to the Graveyard.....only to come back from the dead like an ice cream ZOMBIE! 
This time though used a whey spirit as the colab (which I can 't get) so we've stuck the OG and used Irish Cream Liqueur.  

The cookie pieces, coffee fudge swirls and punch of booze, makes this flavour a warming autumn tub of magic. 

So what's needed for this one:

340g Milk
455g Whipping Cream @35%
120g Sugar
45g Skimmed Milk Powder
50g Glucose syrup/Golden Syrup /Corn Syrup
100ml Baileys Irish Cream (I used 120ml in the video and it was a little too much)
1.3g stabilizer (optional)


For the Coffee Fudge:
50g Sugar
50g Chocolate
15g Cocoa
50g Milk
45g Corn syrup 
7g Coconut oil 
10g Instant Coffee of your choice
Pinch salt

I used store bought cookies but am going to do my best at leaning how to make them soon so keep an eye out for that video!

comments.text:
A good home machine will achieve approximately 20-40% overrun, an average home machine will achieve 10-30% and a cheap home machine will achieve around 10% overrun. 
Almost all fresh milk in the UK is fully homogenized apart from Waitrose, I don’t use that one as the results can vary and it means I need to blend most bases. We are lucky with UK dairy products.
